author: tadelv
name: Wiu Wiu RGB
description: Animates a Bengle's LED strips from machine state: rainbow, breathing or a playthrough colour ramp driven by pressure and flow.

Preset.label: Preset
Preset.description: Active effect: a rotating rainbow, a slow breathing pulse of BreathingColor, or a colour ramp driven by live pressure and flow.

BreathingColor.label: Breathing colour
BreathingColor.description: Colour the breathing preset pulses with, as hex #RRGGBB. A warm white by default.

Brightness.label: Brightness
Brightness.description: Scales every colour, 5 to 100 percent. Values outside that range fall back to 100.

FrameIntervalMs.label: Frame interval (ms)
FrameIntervalMs.description: Spacing between animation frames in milliseconds, 20 to 1000. Lower is smoother and writes the LED registers more often.

PlaythroughPressureMax.label: Pressure at full green
PlaythroughPressureMax.description: Bar that maps to a full green back strip in the playthrough preset.

PlaythroughFlowMax.label: Flow at full blue
PlaythroughFlowMax.description: Flow in ml/s that maps to a full blue front strip in the playthrough preset.

body.description: JSON snapshot: active preset and machine state, transport state, frame/write/dedupe/restore counters, last written colours, last error, live pressure and flow, and uptime.
